<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex070032026-10-1509-04-51" status="unreviewed"> yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">kha cig</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog lo</rs></note> na re byang chub ma thob pa na thob par smon pa ni smon pa sems bskyed yin la | byang chub thob nas phyin du la 'jug pa ni 'jug pa sems bskyed yin pas so skye la med ces gsungs pa ltar na so skye la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa mi srid par thal | 'dod na byang sems sdom pa la brten pa'i rtsa ltung mi srid par thal | lus dang rma bzhin no || 
           'dod pa la rnyed sogs kyi phyir ltung ba 'byung bar gsungs pas bsal lo || 
             <lb n="36b7"/>des na 'phags pa drag shul can gyis zhus pa'i mdo las ser snas yongs su bkris pa la yang bslab pa'i gnas bcas pa 'byung ba la zhes gsung pa la | <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3742">bslab btus</rs> las kyang | ci ser ma chud pa la'ang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yod dam med ce na yod par rigs par bya ste zhes so || </seg></TEI>
